title: Radarr Movie Event File Size Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radarr:event file_size_gb=*
| stats sum(file_size_gb) as total_value, avg(file_size_gb) as avg_value by quality_profile
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks quality profile values by total and average file size across Radarr movie event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `file_size_gb` values for each Radarr movie event event and review total and average file size by quality profile.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total file size.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which quality profile shows the biggest file size numbers in your Radarr movie event data.
